feature_result: 167 normal packages on both sides; all dependency feature sets equal. Root adds only flutter-bridge, enabled by default to preserve the previous unconditional bridge.

macro_result.behavior: The frb macro adds encoded annotations and converts attribute syntax. The opaque/ignore annotations here do not create runtime wrapper calls; importing the exact macro through its re-export or direct dependency is equivalent.

object_delta: SearchEngine gains one private read_only:bool. No atomic, mutex or buffer field was added to that object. Rust layout/codegen impact is not measured by this metadata-only audit.
guard_frequency_in_harness: One ensure_write_access at add_library_books entry for the eight-book batch, not per document or per synchronous query. Other guards in set_economy_indexing/open/commit run outside the sampled concurrent search loop.
new_refresh_path: refresh_line_source/line_source::refresh is added but the unchanged harness only invokes the unchanged configure_line_source path before timing.
hypotheses_not_findings: Object/codegen layout: record size_of and align_of SearchEngine in both identical default builds. Same size/align would not prove identical private-field offsets or generated code.

Sampling phase: current loop sleeps10ms and collects until indexing completes. Compare search_samples and indexing duration already emitted; in a separate instrumented harness retain individual query start times/latencies relative to worker start/finish before attributing tail changes.

Compilation/inlining differences are still possible despite identical dependency features; inspect exact build profile/rustc flags and function code sizes only if controlled timing still separates. No guard removal is proposed.
